description: This file contains asynchronous task functions for loading chart data and explore JSON data into cache within the Superset project, utilizing Celery for task management and handling various exceptions and user context overrides.

methods.name: set_form_data
methods.description: Sets form data into Flask's global context.

methods.name: _create_query_context_from_form
methods.description: Creates a QueryContext object from form data, raising ValidationError if invalid.

methods.name: _load_user_from_job_metadata
methods.description: Determines and loads the User object based on job metadata, handling logged-in, guest, or anonymous users.

methods.name: load_chart_data_into_cache
methods.description: Celery task that loads chart data into cache based on job metadata and form data, handling exceptions and updating job status.

methods.name: load_explore_json_into_cache
methods.description: Celery task that loads explore JSON data into cache, generating cache keys, handling errors, and updating job status.
